limitations: Source-linked paraphrases, not full webpage archives or independently verified private information.
BI was readable via the publisher Reddit link with tracking parameters; the saved URL is canonical. Some direct opens failed.
Syndicated and aggregator repetitions do not provide independent confirmation. Unknown overlap between anonymous sources.
Historical examples were deliberately selected for contrasting outcomes, not sampled to estimate a base rate.
No verified negotiation stage, exclusivity, signed agreement, board timetable, closing readiness, competing bid, or planned announcement date.
No exhaustive search of private communications or regulatory filings; official-page absence is weak negative evidence.
